add.event: 加纳央行资产质量审查发现uniBank严重资本不足
add.evidence: during its Asset Quality Review (AQR) of banks conducted in 2015, and reviewed in 2016, uniBank Ghana LTD was identified to be significantly undercapitalized.

add.event: 加纳央行批准GCB银行接管UT银行与Capital银行
add.evidence: On 14 August 2017, the BoG in its press release announced its approval for the takeover of two indigenous banks, UT Bank LTD and Capital Bank LTD, by GCB Bank LTD.

add.event: 银行危机接近尾声时新冠疫情传入加纳，进一步打击经济
add.evidence: The COVID-19 pandemic arrived in Ghana towards the end of the banking crisis in 2020, dealing further damage to the country's economy.
